rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sequential read of all 13 chunks. Closest-to-violating line: chunk 4 'The craft: spend and route wisely' line 47 'The rest are about what you do with the work once it's in front of you.' — 'the rest' reads as a dangling plural but resolves immediately against that same chunk's own three following bullets (lines 49, 51, 53), the same pattern as chunk 3 line 39 'The first two are about what you let in.' resolving against its own two bullets (41, 43). No referent points forward across a chunk boundary or stays ambiguous with full deck history. Reused terms are same-file earlier-slide reuse, the rule's explicit NOT-violation case: 'the always-loaded file'/'./CLAUDE.md' (ch.4→ch.5), the durable/loud pairing (ch.7→ch.8), subagent-as-firewall (ch.4→ch.9).

Grepped body (lines 1-120, case-insensitive) for module/earlier/previous/prior/this module/the exercise/the lecture/M[1-6]/the opening/last module/next module (run this session): one hit, line 57 'earlier than the token count suggests' — a temporal comparative inside one argument (sooner, not a position), not a cross-file callback. Zero occurrences of 'Module' anywhere in the body — the only 'M2 close'/'M3 module close' text lives in the maintainer Placement note past the line-121 cut, out of body scope. No positional or by-title cross-file callback exists in this body.

All 13 chunks carry a self-sufficient claim. Smallest is chunk 10 'One lever, two payoffs' (49 words, lines 91-94): 'Token efficiency is one lever with two payoffs... The rest is noticing what you loaded and never used.' — a complete standalone summary, not a wait-state or single context-dependent bullet. Both Sources chunks (12-13) are self-carrying citation lists. No chunk is content-free.

Checked all 13 headers against their chunk content. Closest candidate: chunk 8 header 'Drivers of inefficient context: the loud ones' (line 79) opens 'The other kind is loud but shrinking: it announces itself, and its fix usually already shipped.' — 'loud' and 'shrinking' both cash out in the two named drivers below (MCP surface tokens 'largely solved'; cache-bust 'a version-specific defect a later release patches'), so the header holds. No header is contradicted by its own chunk (e.g. 'More rules, worse edits' ch.5 delivers exactly a rules-ceiling argument; 'Put a number on it' ch.2 delivers a dollar figure).

Per sub-item, grepped and read the full body (run this session): 'Not X. Not Y. Z.' construction — zero hits. Anaphora/epistrophe triples (3+ repeated 'Every ...' clauses) — zero hits. Self-grading superlatives ('one of the most', 'game-changing', etc.) — zero hits. Number+own-retraction — the only 'about N' figure in-body is line 33 ('about 10 dollars... 2 dollars'), a stated comparison with its label, not the hedge-then-undercut shape rule 9 names as the exception case ('about 10%... could be more, could be less'), which does not occur anywhere in this body. Abstraction-noun stacks and verb triplets with an empty leg — none found; the craft/drivers sections stay in concrete nouns (the files Claude didn't load, a messy repo, a bloated CLAUDE.md).
